events.title: Wednesday Quiz in the Pattern Shop
events.description: Six rounds, teams of up to six, and a picture round that is always about the river. Winners drink free for the night. No booking; get here by 6:30 for a table.

events.title: Wet Bine Harvest Ale: last call
events.description: The last keg of this year's fresh-hop beer goes on at three. Brewed with hops picked at Hollis Farm the same morning. When it is gone, it is gone until next September.

events.title: Foundry Sessions: The Low Water Marks
events.description: Bluegrass and old-time from a four-piece who met at the Wrenford fiddle contest. Free, all ages until 8pm. The Smoke Signal barbecue truck is outside.

events.title: Riverside Makers Market
events.description: Twenty local makers on the loading dock and the foundry floor: ceramics, prints, leather, honey and hot sauce. Dogs welcome on the dock.

events.title: Brew Day 101 with our head brewer
events.description: Three hours on the brewhouse floor learning all-grain brewing on our pilot system. You take home a fermenter of your own pale ale and a recipe sheet. Twelve places, 21+.

events.title: Pierogi Night with the Ferry Street Wagon
events.description: Potato and cheese, sauerkraut and mushroom, and a sweet plum one for afters, all made by hand. Best with a Pour Line Pilsner.

events.title: Stout Day: the Banked Fire pour
events.description: Our bourbon barrel-aged imperial stout goes on tap all day, with a vertical of last year's batch for comparison. Limited 750 ml bottles to take home, two per person.

events.title: Tamsen River clean-up
events.description: Gloves, bags and coffee from 9am at the foot of Foundry Row, with the Wrenford River Trust. Everyone who helps gets a pint on us when the taproom opens at noon.
